name: Ze Lake
source:
A bounty hunter who travels the world. He is exceptionally proficient with bows and enjoys practicing with them in his spare time. He is particularly fixed on becoming stronger.

He doesn't like to talk about himself and often goes into the Forgotten Forest to hunt. He comes from the ancient battle family Rick. His father's death rankles in his mind, and he was even the boss of the Back Street for a short time because of it- of course, he sees this a dark history and doesn't talk about it at all. He prefers to speak to animals more than humans and owns a horse named Raven.

His father used to say to him: "I will only pass my bow to the one who can shoot down St. Elmo's fire." This sentence resonates in his head, and he hopes one day he will be able to find out the truth behind his father's death and seek revenge.

[Edited from in-game bio]
